latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the OpenClaw Agent Creator for Arch's multi-agent system.
- Supports full agent lifecycle: directory setup, workspace file creation (SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, etc.), and openclaw.json configuration.
